jobs.title: Support Associate
jobs.description: BiltOn is a leading start-up company in the field of Construction Tech that develops and implements systems for managing construction sites in the field of safety and quality. The system provides control for managers and makes the information accessible in real time. We are growing at a fast pace and we are looking for a Support associate. In our Support team there is no typical day, and to be successful in the Support Associate role you will need to be self-motivated, creative and have excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills to be able to support our customers and Partners. Location: Ramat Gan Job scope: Sunday-Thursday 9:00-18:00 (with availability for at least 1 morning shift - 7:00-15:00). What You'll Be Doing: Assist users via phone, WhatsApp, chat, and email - guiding them through the platform, answering "how-to" questions, and ensuring a standout customer experience. Apply strong technical intuition to isolate root causes when issues arise and resolve application-level challenges. Manage day-to-day platform operations, including user management, site setup, and report generation. Partner closely with Product, Development, and Customer Success Managers to escalate bugs, share user feedback, and drive issue resolution. Requirements: 1+ years of experience in a Customer Service / Support role - Must Excellent written communication skills, fast typing speed, and strong attention to detail Hands-on experience with Salesforce (or similar CRM systems) – Strong Advantage Fluency in both Hebrew and English (written and spoken) – Must Strong team player with a proven ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams Creative problem-solver with a strong "can-do" attitude, ownership, and adaptability to a fast-paced startup environment If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership, and being part of an extremely ambitious team, then click below to apply and get the conversation going!

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: BiltOn is a fast-growing startup building an AI-powered safety and risk management platform purpose-built for enterprise General Contractors. We help construction teams connect the field, trailer, and office by delivering consistent onsite visibility, accurate operational data, and proactive tools for managing safety, compliance, productivity, and risk. Our platform modernizes field operations, including workforce tracking, safety routines, incident reporting, safety checklists, and credential compliance. By connecting field activity and compliance data to worker, company, and trade profiles, we help safety and operations teams eliminate administrative waste, improve execution, stay compliance-ready, and reduce insurance risk. About the Role: We are looking for an experienced, technical, and execution-driven Senior Product Manager (IC role reporting to the VP Product) to take end-to-end ownership of major modules within our complex B2B SaaS ecosystem. Thriving in a fast-moving startup environment, you will help define the product roadmap and independently drive domain priorities, scoping, execution, and iteration. You will collaborate closely with R&D, Design, GTM teams, and enterprise customers to quickly turn lean concepts into valuable, real-world field solutions. This is a Product Manager role of the future. We expect you to use AI as a core daily tool, not just an accessory. The right candidate leverages AI to actively expand the traditional PM skillset—independently generating PRDs, UX flows, prototypes, demos, and research summaries to move faster with less dependency on Design, Data, or R&D. What You’ll Do: Own major product modules end-to-end—from strategy through launch and adoption—and shape the global roadmap while keeping the product scalable and focused. Break complex enterprise needs into lean, iterative phases (POC, MVP, V1) and write detailed, implementation-ready PRDs, user stories, and UX flows. Partner closely with R&D and Design to craft intuitive field workflows and make smart tradeoffs between product value, technical complexity, and delivery speed. Actively use AI tools daily to generate prototypes, PRDs, research summaries, and demos, while helping define, build, and validate AI capabilities within the platform itself. Deeply understand user needs by analyzing Gong calls, syncing with internal teams, and engaging directly with US enterprise customers through weekly calls and construction site visits. Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success on positioning and enablement to drive measurable adoption, operational efficiency, and customer value. Requirements: 5+ years of hands-on Product Management, and experience building complex B2B SaaS products in a fast-paced startup environment - a must Proven experience working as part of a product team with R&D and Design - a must Hands-on, daily experience using AI-based products, prototyping, and coding tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor, v0, Lovable, Magic Patterns, Base44, or Figma AI). Strong technical orientation with deep understanding of APIs, system architecture, data structures, permissions, and technical dependencies. Proven ability to break complex scope into lean iterative phases (POC, MVP, V1) and write detailed, implementation-ready PRDs, user stories, and UX flows. Strong business judgment and prioritization skills to balance enterprise customer needs, roadmap goals, and technical tradeoffs under ambiguity. Positive, highly accountable execution style with strong collaboration skills across opinionated R&D, Design, and cross-functional teams. High fluency in both English and Hebrew. Advantages: Domain experience in construction, field operations, safety, compliance, or workforce management. Background working on mobile-first or field-facing operational products. Experience with complex enterprise systems (ERPs, CRMs, role-based permissions, advanced reporting). Prior experience working directly with US-based enterprise customers.

jobs.title: Senior / Lead Product Designer
jobs.description: About the Role BiltOn is looking for a hands-on Senior Product Designer to lead the design quality of our AI-powered B2B SaaS platform for the construction industry. You'll own the end-to-end product design process—from complex requirements to polished, implementation-ready experiences—while serving as the company's design authority. You'll work closely with Product, R&D, Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing to create intuitive, scalable experiences for both field users and enterprise customers. This is an AI-first role. You'll leverage modern AI tools to accelerate UX flows, wireframes, prototypes, mockups, and product concepts, using Figma where it adds the most value for production-ready design, design systems, and quality. What You'll Do Own the UX/UI design of a complex B2B SaaS platform. Lead design reviews and raise the overall design quality. Turn product requirements into clear, scalable user experiences. Use AI tools to speed up ideation, prototyping, and design workflows. Maintain and evolve the design system and UX standards. Collaborate closely with Product and R&D to ensure high-quality implementation. Help Product Managers use AI for design while defining when deeper design involvement is needed. What You'll Bring 5+ years of Product Design experience. Experience designing complex B2B SaaS products. Strong UX, UI, and design system expertise. Advanced Figma skills. Hands-on experience with AI design tools (Figma Make, Magic Patterns, Claude, etc.). Experience working in fast-paced startup environments. Excellent collaboration and communication skills. High ownership, curiosity, and an AI-first mindset. Nice to Have Experience with Construction Tech, Safety, Compliance, or Field Operations. Mobile-first product design experience. Experience with enterprise platforms, dashboards, and data-heavy products. Why Join Us BiltOn solves a real, painful, high-value problem for large construction companies. Our product is used by people in the field and by enterprise leaders managing safety, compliance, productivity, and risk at scale. You will design for a rare product challenge: experiences simple enough for field users and powerful enough for executives, admins, and enterprise safety teams. You will also help bring AI into an industry with massive potential, real operational complexity, and clear adoption challenges. This is a role for someone who wants hands-on design ownership, company-wide design influence, AI-first workflows, complex product challenges, and direct impact on a product with heavy real-world usage.
